problem: Exact-main production contained the i18n stylesheet and V18 mobile drawer but zero language controls because the canonical shell rebuild stripped /assets/js/i18n.js.
root_cause: tools/site-shell/apply-shell.mjs reconstructs page scripts through TOEGESTANE_SCRIPTS. The central i18n runtime was not allowlisted, so shell projection removed it after earlier build stages had injected it.
prevention: Canonical shell script allowlist must preserve /assets/js/i18n.js on public pages.
Static i18n asset presence must prove both CSS and runtime script survive final shell projection.
Terminal production proof must require a visible language selector in the real V18 drawer and NL→EN→NL routing.
